gatewayNotice: Loaded gateway connection. Maintain infrastructure in Nacos and restart explicitly after changes. Authentication credentials are not displayed.
name: Name
failed: Request failed. Refresh the current version before retrying.
confirmStop: Stop this instance and cancel its managed orders?
confirmCancel: Cancel all managed orders for this stopped instance?
parameterNotice: Save complete parameters in the database. Restart core services after creating or changing parameters before starting. Stop the instance before editing.
syntheticNotice: Development publications stream directly from market data, without financial fills or database records.
sourceFrequencyNotice: Aggregated trades: 0 follows the selected source events; a positive value sets the sampling interval. Book mode requires a positive interval.
bindingNotice: Trading account ownership is permanent. Disable to revoke access; account history cannot transfer to another merchant.
snapshotNotice: Current matching-gateway snapshot. Failed observations do not fall back to local order history.
staleSnapshot: Snapshot expired. Refresh to observe current state.
syntheticHistoryNotice: Historical development records only. Current WashTrade publications are sent directly and do not add database records here.
longGridNotice: Long only with cross margin. Opens the first lot on start, buys one spacing lower and sells the corresponding lot one spacing higher. A stop below venue average entry closes the position and halts the strategy until explicitly started again. Quantities follow the market lot step. Close positions before editing parameters.
accountEnrollmentNotice: Connect an existing venue user and fund. The user must already be authorized for this merchant. Configure strategies separately after adding the account.
tradingIDRequired: Enter a valid positive account ID
enableAccountBeforeStart: Enable the trading account on the accounts page before starting the strategy
readOnlyParametersNotice: Read-only view of the complete saved parameters. Stop the instance before editing.
makerCheckNotice: Uses current source data and matching account observations to check quotation inputs and total budget. Live funds, exposure and execution risk checks still apply. Requested running does not indicate active orders.
makerCheckPassed: Current quotation inputs and total budget check passed
makerBudgetInsufficient: Target quotation notional exceeds the account limit; review the limit or strategy parameters
makerSnapshotUnavailable: A fresh matching account observation is unavailable; check again later
makerSourceUnavailable: The selected source has no fresh two-sided book
makerTargetsInvalid: Quotation parameters do not match current market rules
makerCheckExpired: The check expired; check again before starting
accountParametersNotice: Saving applies immediately to subsequent orders of all linked instances without restarting. Existing orders follow strategy refresh; positions are not adjusted automatically. Stop strategies, cancel orders and close positions before changing leverage. The total limit must cover current matching exposure.
accountPolicyConflict: Account parameters changed; refresh the list before editing again
accountPolicyExposure: The new total limit is below current matching exposure; cancel orders or reduce positions first
accountPolicyPositionLeverage: Close current positions before changing leverage
accountPolicyGridLimit: The new limits are below linked long grid order or position budgets; update the grid first
accountPolicySnapshotUnavailable: A fresh matching account observation is unavailable; try saving again later
accountPolicyFailed: Save was not confirmed; refresh and verify account parameters before retrying
accountLeverageNotice: Trading account leverage governs orders. Saving account parameters applies to subsequent orders of all linked instances immediately.
accountPolicyOrderLeverage: Stop strategies and cancel current orders before changing leverage
confirmDisableAccount: Disable the {{symbol}} trading account? New orders will be blocked. Existing orders must be cancelled separately.
stopBeforeEdit: Stop the instance before editing parameters
